title.narrative: Going Bananas – Restoring livelihoods of conflict affected farmers in Cotabato

description.narrative: This project aims to contribute to peace and sustainable economic development by restoration of agriculture based livelihoods for over 12,000 farmer households in Carmen, North Cotabato.By introducing climate resilient farming, incentives in the form of seedlings, improved market conditions and landscape interventions, the farmers will become productive smallholders.This will result in an improved income for at least 2,000 farmers and an increase in nutritional value and food security for their families (9,000 individuals).
